known difference: Lane P4f7: docx-agent's copy_blocks reads the ids the document had (_known_ids) before _prepare stamps it, so a paraId or drawing id its stamping gave a replaced block, deleted before the copy is stamped, is given again to the copy (the id is both removed and created). The Rust core never gives an id twice (the ledger's rule); its copy takes the next id. A docx-agent leftover, not copied.
